default.description: Information Retrieval (IR) Semester 7 practicals for SPPU BE students, covering text preprocessing, inverted-index retrieval, Bayesian classification, spam filtering, hierarchical clustering, PageRank, and web crawling.

questions.title: Text Preprocessing: Stop-word Removal and Stemming
questions.question: Write a program to preprocess a text document by tokenizing it, removing stop words, and stemming the remaining words.

questions.title: Document Retrieval using an Inverted Index
questions.question: Implement retrieval of documents using an inverted file (inverted index). Build postings from a collection of documents and rank documents matching a user query.

questions.title: Bayesian Network for Heart Disease Data
questions.question: Construct a simple Bayesian network using medical features and demonstrate heart-disease classification. The answer uses a small example dataset and Naive Bayes conditional probabilities. This educational example is not a medical diagnostic tool.

questions.title: E-mail Spam Filtering using Text Classification
questions.question: Implement e-mail spam filtering using a text classification algorithm and an appropriate labeled dataset. Report precision, recall, F1-score, and a confusion matrix.

questions.title: Agglomerative Hierarchical Clustering
questions.question: Implement an agglomerative hierarchical clustering algorithm using an appropriate dataset. Visualize the dendrogram and report cluster assignments.

questions.title: PageRank Algorithm
questions.question: Implement the PageRank algorithm using Python or Beautiful Soup. Demonstrate the ranking on a directed web graph.

questions.title: Web Crawler for E-commerce Product Information
questions.question: Build a web crawler to collect product information and links from an e-commerce website. Respect the website's terms, robots.txt, rate limits, and access controls; demonstrate with a site you own or have permission to crawl.
